title: Plan and billing
description: Your plan, usage and bill so far, credits and invoices.

planLine.free: 1 device, 20 AI actions a month, 30 days of history. Safety is always on.
planLine.trial: Up to 3 devices during your trial.
planLine.pro: $5 a month with 2 active devices, 300 AI actions and 300 cloud-agent minutes.
planLine.company_trial: All Company features during the trial.
planLine.company: $15 per active seat a month, at least 3 seats. 300 AI actions and minutes per seat, shared.

readOnlyNotice: This workspace is read-only. You can still look around and export your data. Choose a plan to make changes again.
pastDueNotice: The last payment failed. Update your payment method in the billing portal within 14 days to keep your plan. Protection keeps working either way.
frozenNotice: A card payment is disputed, so paid features are paused while we review it. Protection keeps working: blocks, approvals, the vault and the audit record are not affected.
safetyNote: Safety is never metered. Blocks, approvals, the vault and the audit record keep working whatever your plan, usage or credits.

usageCard.title: Usage and bill so far
usageCard.description: This month, in UTC. Credits update as you use them.
usageCard.activeHelp: A device or seat is active when it is online on 3 or more different days in the month. Only active ones are billed; protection stays on for all. Updated hourly.
usageCard.vat: In US dollars, with AED for reference. UAE VAT of 5% is added for buyers in the UAE.

wallet.title: Credits
wallet.description: Credits pay for AI actions and cloud-agent minutes above what your plan includes. 1 credit = 1 AI action or 1 minute. $5 buys 1,000 credits, valid for 12 months.
wallet.spent: {spent, number} of {cap, number} credits spent this month above your allowance
wallet.spentNoCap: {spent, number} credits spent this month above your allowance, no cap
wallet.capHelp: When the cap is reached, AI answers and cloud agents pause until next month or until you raise it. Protection is never paused.
wallet.autoTopUpHelp: Buy $10 of credits when the balance falls below $2, at most 3 times a month. Charged to your saved card with a tax invoice.
wallet.error: That did not work. Try again.
wallet.rules: Alerts reach you by email and here at 50%, 80% and 100% of your allowance and of your cap.

banner.near: You have used 80% of this month's included AI actions or minutes, or of your cap.
banner.credits: Your included AI actions are used up; credits are paying for more.
banner.noCredits: AI answers and cloud agents are paused: this month's allowance is used up and there are no credits left. Add credits to continue.
banner.free: AI answers are paused: this month's 20 included AI actions are used up. Buy a credit pack or upgrade to continue.
banner.cap: AI answers and cloud agents are paused: your monthly spend cap is reached. Raise the cap to continue.

trialCancel.body: Your Company trial ends on {date}. After that your card is charged $15 per active seat a month, at least 3 seats. Cancel now and nothing is charged.
trialCancel.done: Your trial is cancelled. Nothing was charged. Your workspace moves to the Free plan and protection keeps working.

actions.title: Change plan
actions.companyTrial: Start a 14-day trial (card needed, not charged)
actions.companyMonthly: Company, $15 per active seat a month
actions.trialHelp: The trial is free for 14 days. After it, your card is charged unless you cancel; we remind you on days 7, 12 and 14. One trial per company and card, with a work email.

prices.pro: Pro is $5 a month or $50 a year with 2 active devices included; each extra active device is $2 a month.
prices.company: Company is $15 per active seat a month, at least 3 seats ($45), or $150 per seat a year. Extra seats above a yearly commitment are $15 a month.

errors.work_email_required: A company trial needs a verified work email. Talk to us if you use a personal address.
errors.trial_used: This company or card has already had a trial. Talk to us and we will help.

enterprise: Enterprise is licensed. Talk to us to change it.
disabled: Billing is not turned on for this deployment.
success: Thanks. Your plan updates in a moment.
creditsSuccess: Thanks. Your credits arrive in a moment.
actionError: Could not open billing. Try again.
contactRequired: Confirm a contact email before you pay, so your receipt has somewhere to go.
